coreMemory.english: v. to continue to be in the same state
coreMemory.structure: remain calm /rɪˈmeɪn kɑm/（保持冷静）；remain unchanged /rɪˈmeɪn əntʃeɪndʒd/（保持不变）；remain in place /rɪˈmeɪn ɪn pleɪs/（留在原地）；remain to be seen /rɪˈmeɪn tu bi sin/（尚待观察）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to remain → ✅ can remain；❌ to remaining → ✅ to remain

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。

coreMemory.derivatives: 本词暂无需额外强记的高频派生词
